children: CoreWeave intends to raise $3.0 billion via convertible senior notes due 2033, with a $500 million greenshoe, and establishes an equity distribution program for up to 35,000,000 shares.
Announced private offering of $3.0B convertible senior notes due April 1, 2033; initial purchasers may buy an extra $500M.
Notes will be general senior unsecured obligations, guaranteed on a senior unsecured basis by certain wholly-owned subsidiaries.
Plans to enter capped call transactions to cover shares underlying the notes to reduce dilution and fund those costs with offering proceeds.
Entered Equity Distribution Agreement enabling sale of up to 35,000,000 Class A shares via agents or through collared forward sale agreements.
Net proceeds to be used to fund capped call costs and for general corporate purposes, including potential debt repayment and capital needs.
